mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: King STDX thrust bearings reported over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 and S65 blocks, confirmed across multiple separate blocks. Poster concludes King bearings cannot be trusted if a fundamental dimension is that far off.

mentions.title: King main and rod bearings marked STDX
mentions.snippet: Free-spread spec called out as out of spec so the bearing does not seat tightly, with similar reports across both 2024 and 2025 production runs and no corrected run expected before January 2027.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; no King or official brand representative has replied, and it remains open and unresolved.
